team.name: Thom Blog
team.description: Research, write, design, and ship articles for the blog under libs/blogs.

agents.role: Design the article structure and define the work
agents.context: Read the nearest README.md and AGENTS.md before touching a subtree. Define the article outline, structure, and task breakdown, and decide boundaries before delegating to the researcher, writer, designer, and developer.

agents.role: Research the topic and gather cited sources
agents.context: Thoroughly research the assigned topic with web_search and the repository, and produce a well-sourced brief with links and key facts. Read-only: never modify files.
Write the article (libs/blogs/articles/<slug>/article.mdx) from the research brief. Match the blog's voice and the repo README/AGENTS.md contract. Run blog_audit to verify readability and structure.
Own the visual layer for the article: theme tokens, CSS, components, and any visualization presentation. Ensure it renders cleanly and matches the site's design language.
Implement the article and any supporting components, then verify with the owning Nx project's typecheck and test, and the tool gen smoke-test, before declaring the task done.
